proof_body:
by
  intro a b c d e f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, y⟩, ⟨h1, h2⟩, hu⟩ hD
    have h1' : a * x + b * y = e := h1
    have h2' : c * x + d * y = f := h2
    have hu' : ∀ u v : ℝ, a * u + b * v = e → c * u + d * v = f → u = x ∧ v = y := by
      intro u v hA hB
      have h := hu (u, v) ⟨hA, hB⟩
      exact ⟨congrArg Prod.fst h, congrArg Prod.snd h⟩
    have A := hu' (x - b) (y + a) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have B := hu' (x - d) (y + c) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hb : b = 0 := by linarith [A.1]
    have ha : a = 0 := by linarith [A.2]
    have hd : d = 0 := by linarith [B.1]
    have hc : c = 0 := by linarith [B.2]
    have C := hu' (x + 1) y (by rw [ha, hb] at h1' ⊢; linarith) (by rw [hc, hd] at h2' ⊢; linarith)
    linarith [C.1]
  · intro hD
    refine ⟨((e * d - b * f) / (a * d - b * c), (a * f - e * c) / (a * d - b * c)), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · show a * ((e * d - b * f) / (a * d - b * c)) + b * ((a * f - e * c) / (a * d - b * c)) = e
      have hs : a * ((e * d - b * f) / (a * d - b * c)) + b * ((a * f - e * c) / (a * d - b * c)) = (a * (e * d - b * f) + b * (a * f - e * c)) / (a * d - b * c) := by ring
      rw [hs, div_eq_iff hD]
      ring
    · show c * ((e * d - b * f) / (a * d - b * c)) + d * ((a * f - e * c) / (a * d - b * c)) = f
      have hs : c * ((e * d - b * f) / (a * d - b * c)) + d * ((a * f - e * c) / (a * d - b * c)) = (c * (e * d - b * f) + d * (a * f - e * c)) / (a * d - b * c) := by ring
      rw [hs, div_eq_iff hD]
      ring
    · rintro ⟨u, v⟩ ⟨h1, h2⟩
      have h1' : a * u + b * v = e := h1
      have h2' : c * u + d * v = f := h2
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
      · show u = (e * d - b * f) / (a * d - b * c)
        rw [eq_div_iff hD, ← h1', ← h2']
        ring
      · show v = (a * f - e * c) / (a * d - b * c)
        rw [eq_div_iff hD, ← h1', ← h2']
        ring
target_source: ∀ (a b c d e f : ℝ), (∃! p : ℝ × ℝ, a * p.1 + b * p.2 = e ∧ c * p.1 + d * p.2 = f) ↔ a * d - b * c ≠ 0
